The 4-digit codes are for conventionally grown produce. 5-digit codes using the 3000 and 4000 series are used to identify organic produce. The prefix of '9' would be placed in front of the 4-digit conventionally grown code for organic produce.

If it is a 4 digit number, the food was conventionally grown, but if a 9 is placed in front of the 4 digits it is organic... Examples: 4011 are standard yellow bananas and 94011 are organically grown yellow bananas.

Carrots that have their tops/greens still attached are most likely to be freshest.

When you buy frozen vegetables, choose bags whose contents feel as if they are in individual pieces instead of a solid mass. The latter can indicate that the product defrosted at some point and then was refrozen.

Avoid bags with clumped produce or visible frost, as these may indicate improper storage or refreezing. | Check labels for added sugar, sodium or fat, and opt for plain, unseasoned frozen fruits and vegetables.
